  margin-bottom: 1.5rem;
}

```{r echo=FALSE, results='asis'}
checklist_items <- subset(task_list_data, sub_page == page_desc)

# -------------------------
# Downloads
# -------------------------
cat("<div class='download-box'>")
cat("<h2>Download Printable Task Lists</h2>")

printables <- checklist_items %>%
  pivot_longer(
    fpc_task:sl_task,
    names_to = "leader",
    values_to = "done"
  ) %>%
  filter(done == "T") %>%
  mutate(person = case_when(
    leader == "fpc_task" ~ "FPC",
    leader == "dl_task" ~ "Deck Lead",
    leader == "sl_task" ~ "Safety Lead"
  )) %>%
  select(Category = section, Task = title, Items = subtitle, person) %>%
  split(.$person)

for (i in seq_along(printables)) {
  outfile <- paste0(
    "../data/",
    page_desc,
    "_",
    names(printables)[i],
    ".xlsx"
  )
  printables[[i]] %>%
    select(-person) %>%
    writexl::write_xlsx(outfile)
  cat(
    paste0(
      "<p><a href='", outfile, "'>",
      names(printables)[i],
      " Task List</a></p>"
    )
  )
}

cat("</div>")

# -------------------------
# Format checklist table
# -------------------------
tabl <- checklist_items %>%
  arrange(section, title, subtitle) %>%
  group_by(section) %>%
  mutate(n = cumsum(!duplicated(title))) %>%
  mutate(
    title = ifelse(
      !is.na(url_loc) & is.na(subtitle),
      paste0(n, ". <a href='", url_loc, "'>", title, "</a>"),
      paste0(n, ". ", title)
    ),
    subtitle = ifelse(
      !is.na(url_loc) & !is.na(subtitle),
      paste0("<a href='", url_loc, "'>", subtitle, "</a>"),
      subtitle
    ),
    subtitle = ifelse(
      is.na(subtitle),
      "",
      paste0("• ", subtitle)
    )
  ) %>%
  mutate(across(
    c(fpc_task, dl_task, sl_task),
    ~ ifelse(. == "T", "✓", "")
  )) %>%
  ungroup()

sections <- unique(tabl$section)


# nav links
cat("\n\n```{=html}\n<div class='nav-links'>\n") # Added raw block start
for (sec in sections) {
  anchor <- gsub(" ", "-", tolower(sec))
  cat(paste0("<a href='#", anchor, "'>", sec, "</a> "))
}
cat("\n</div>\n```\n<br>\n") # Added raw block end

# render each section separately
for (sec in sections) {
  anchor <- gsub(" ", "-", tolower(sec))

  # Start Section Card with Raw HTML block
  cat(paste0("\n\n```{=html}\n<div class='section-card'>\n<h2 id='", anchor, "'>", sec, "</h2>\n"))

  g <- tabl %>%
    filter(section == sec) %>%
    group_by(title) %>%
    mutate(
      last_row = row_number() == n(),
      # Determine if we need to show the title and the first subtitle together
      task_display = case_when(
        row_number() == 1 & subtitle != "" ~ paste0(
          "<div class='task-main'>", title, "</div>",
          "<div class='task-sub'>", subtitle, "</div>"
        ),
        row_number() == 1 & subtitle == "" ~ paste0(
          "<div class='task-main'>", title, "</div>"
        ),
        TRUE ~ paste0(
          "<div class='task-sub'>", subtitle, "</div>"
        )
      )
    ) %>%
    ungroup()

  table_html <- knitr::kable(
    g %>% select(task_display, fpc_task, dl_task, sl_task),
    format = "html",
    escape = FALSE,
    col.names = c("Task", "FPC", "Deck Lead", "Safety Lead"),
    align = c("l", "c", "c", "c")
  ) %>%
    kableExtra::kable_styling(bootstrap_options = "condensed", full_width = TRUE) %>%
    kableExtra::column_spec(1, width = "75%")

  last_rows <- which(g$last_row)
  for (r in last_rows) {
    table_html <- table_html %>%
      kableExtra::row_spec(r, extra_css = "border-bottom: 1.5px solid #e5e7eb;")
  }

  # Print the table, then close the section card div inside the raw block
  cat(as.character(table_html))
  cat("\n</div>\n```\n<br>\n") # Added raw block end
}
```
